# 2008 Elections

There were 5 elections held in Jersey in 2008.

- **[St Helier Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2008#e9)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · 19% turnout
- **[St Clement Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2008#e40)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2008#e10)**

  6 seats · 21 candidates · 44.1% turnout
- **[Connétables General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2008#e11)**

  12 seats (8 uncontested) · 17 candidates · 50.2% turnout
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2008#e12)**

  29 seats (4 uncontested) · 67 candidates · 34.5% average turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

## 2008 St Helier Connétable Election

**[Simon Crowcroft](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft) was elected as Connétable of St Helier in 2008**.
